27.02.2026 WPMS No.278 of 2026
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
Heard Mr. Jai Krishna Pandey, learned 
counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Bharat 
Singh, learned counsel for the respondent
no.2. 
2. On 24.02.2026, Mr. Bharat Singh, 
Advocate submitted that the petitioner has 
an outstanding due of Rs.4,11,246/-. On 
that day, Mr. Jai Krishna Pandey, had 
sought time to deposit the said amount. 
3. Today, Mr. Jai Krishna Pandey, 
Advocate submitted that the petitioner has 
deposited the said amount under protest 
before the Labour Court, Haridwar. 
4. Mr. Bharat Singh, Advocate has sought 
four weeks’ time to file counter affidavit. 
5. Time is granted. 
6. List on 06.05.2026. Till then, the 
proceedings of execution are stayed.
7. Interim Relief Application (IA No.2 of 
2026) stands disposed of accordingly. 
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 
JKJ/Pant 27.02.2026
